description: Authorizes posting a message to a Slack channel only with a signed approval from a trusted person for that channel. The content review and channel authorization signals come from the caller, so they can only refuse a post, never authorize one on their own.

unboundSignalReasons.contentApproved: Declared by the caller. It can refuse a post, never authorize one on its own; only the signed approval behind postApproved authorizes a post.
unboundSignalReasons.channelAuthorized: Declared by the caller. The channel is also checked against the server's allowlist. It can refuse a post, never authorize one on its own.

outcome.reason: Message post authorized with a verified approval for this channel.
Message post rejected. A post needs a signed approval for this channel in signals.approvalArtifact, with postApproved true, and every other policy condition satisfied.
